mapper.sql: t_personal_gift.id, t_personal_gift.creator, t_personal_gift.updater, t_personal_gift.deleter, t_personal_gift.create_time, t_personal_gift.update_time, t_personal_gift.delete_time, t_personal_gift.operator, t_personal_gift.operate_time, t_personal_gift.event_name, t_personal_gift.amount, t_personal_gift.other_person, t_personal_gift.event_time, t_personal_gift.remarks, t_personal_gift.`action`, t_personal_gift.notice_num
mapper.select:
select from t_personal_gift
and is_delete = 0
order by operate_time desc

if.if: and (t_personal_gift.event_name like concat('%', #{personalGiftVo.keyword}, '%') or t_personal_gift.other_person like concat('%', #{personalGiftVo.keyword}, '%') or t_personal_gift.remarks like concat('%', #{personalGiftVo.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT t_contacts.id as contactsUserId, t_contacts.name as contactsUserName, t_contacts.relationship, MAX(t_gift.event_time) as lastContactTime, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '1' THEN t_gift.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftOutAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '2' THEN t_gift.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftInAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '2' THEN t_gift.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '1' THEN t_gift.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as netAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '1' THEN 1 END) as giftOutCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '2' THEN 1 END) as giftInCount FROM t_contacts_user t_contacts LEFT JOIN t_personal_gift t_gift ON t_contacts.id = t_gift.contacts_user_id AND t_gift.is_delete = 0 WHERE t_contacts.is_delete = 0 GROUP BY t_contacts.id, t_contacts.name, t_contacts.relationship ORDER BY lastContactTime DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_gift.event_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '1' THEN t_gift.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftOutAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '2' THEN t_gift.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftInAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '1' THEN 1 END) as giftOutCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN t_gift.action = '2' THEN 1 END) as giftInCount FROM t_personal_gift t_gift WHERE t_gift.is_delete = 0 AND t_gift.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t_gift.event_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
